description: This file defines the AccountsParseRule class, which extends BaseRule, and primarily implements the preParse method to modify panel data for account detail views based on certain matching patterns. It adjusts panel fields such as 'parent_id' to 'parent_name' and performs custom code replacements within address fields.

classes.name: AccountsParseRule
classes.description: A class extending BaseRule that provides custom pre-processing logic for account panels in views, particularly modifying row data based on field matching patterns.

methods.name: preParse
methods.description: Processes the panels data before rendering, replacing 'parent_id' with 'parent_name' and updating address field custom code in the panels for the detail view.
